# MathJax 3.2.2

`tex-svg-3.2.2.js` is the unmodified MathJax 3.2.2 TeX/SVG combined component:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js

It includes the SVG glyph data, so normal reading formulas render without CDN
scripts or external mathematical font downloads. Optional TeX extensions loaded
on demand still use the pinned upstream CDN path configured in `reading.html`.

Upstream: https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax/tree/3.2.2
License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`).
